name: Sun Totem
source: Qadira, Jewel of the East pg. 29
body:
Sun Totem (Su)
Source Qadira, Jewel of the East pg. 29
The touch of flame fuels and bolsters the barbarian’s rage. She gains fire resistance 10 when raging. In addition, for 1d6 rounds after coming in direct contact with open flame, her speed increases by 10 feet. A barbarian must have the lesser sun totem rage power and be at least 6th level to select this rage power.
